LEGISLATIVE HISTORY
 1. L. N. 231/1963 (G.N. Sp. No. S 4/1963) — Modification of Laws (Internal
                                             Security and Public Order)
                                             (Singapore) Order, 1963
     Commencement                   :    16 September 1963
     Note: This Order extended the Federation of Malaya Visiting Forces
           Act, 1960 (M. Act 23 of 1960) with modifications to Singapore.

 2. 1970 Revised Edition — Visiting Forces Act (Chapter 237)
     Operation                      :    31 July 1971
